claims.scope: Float128::toPackedFloat normalization of mantissa to M_MANTISSA (38) or L_MANTISSA (72)

preconditions.text: The input floating point number has more than 38 digits (38 < digits < 72).; The input's exponent is quite less than MAXIMUM_EXPONENT.; The input mantissa is not exactly 38 or 72 digits long and thus requires normalization.; Floating points with 38 < digits < 72 are valid inputs for this library, as confirmed by the sponsor.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: toPackedFloat should select L_MANTISSA (72) rather than M_MANTISSA (38) for valid inputs with 38 < digits < 72, preserving their precision.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: Significant precision loss occurs for floating point numbers with digits > 38.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。
